title: Raw-git ratchet baseline is still one exact-match file every shrinking lane must edit
summary: The size ratchet is now a ceiling with one boundary writer (ratchet-tighten opens a tighten PR). go/internal/rawgitratchet/baseline.json has the same shared-file shape, and rawgitratchet.Check is still exact-match: two lanes that each shrink raw-git fixture sites must both edit that file, so a rebase of one over the other is never treeDelta-identical (docs/architecture/packages/internal-sizeratchet.md, 'The raw-git half: a follow-up').
fix: Apply the same ceiling rule to rawgitratchet.Check (a shrink is slack, growth and a new site still fail), and extend the one writer: a tighten over a map[string]int with a per-list floor (MaxLines for the size list, zero sites for the raw-git list) that the boundary ratchet-tighten step runs for both lists in the same tighten PR. This is a design step, not a copy of tighten.go.
acceptance: A lane that removes raw-git fixture sites passes the ratchet without editing baseline.json
Growth past a baseline count and a new raw-git site both still fail the ratchet
The boundary ratchet-tighten step lowers baseline.json in the same tighten pull request as offenders.json
Two lanes that shrink sites in different packages rebase identically under treedelta.Identical (test)
